paper.title: News on TikTok: An Annotated Dataset of TikTok Videos from German-Speaking News Outlets in 2023

collection_methods: Researcher access program (TikTok Research API, Meta Content Library, DSA Art. 40)
collection.scale_description_verbatim: an annotated dataset of 8,623 TikTok videos published by 18 major German-speaking news outlets in 2023

tasks_verbatim: develop and validate automated tools for analyzing visual and auditory elements of news content
systematic exploration of news content on TikTok
annotation_paradigms: Expert, author or trained student annotation
annotation.iaa_summary_verbatim: until the variables exhibited satisfactory intercoder reliability values of Krippendorff's α ≥ 0.800

hosting_repositories: Domain archive (ICPSR, GESIS, Dryad, Mendeley Data)

ethics.anonymization_details: The dataset contains neither the TikTok videos nor the video descriptions; it provides unique video IDs and video URLs, and does not save personally identifiable information on the level of single individuals.

evidence.availability_quote: The dataset can be found in the open-access GESIS repository (Wedel et al. 2025): https://doi.org/10.7802/2863
evidence.scale_quote: The dataset encompasses all annotated TikTok videos published in 2023 by 18 major Germanspeaking news outlets (N = 8,623).
evidence.annotation_quote: The human annotation of the videos with a codebook was subsequently conducted from September 2024 and February 2025.
evidence.ethics_quote: We did not seek formal approval from the Institutional Review Board (IRB) at our institutions, but oriented our research according to the basic guidelines for safeguarding good research practice
evidence.license_quote: The dataset is re-usable under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license.
evidence.ambiguity_notes: The paper does not report a single numeric IAA value; only a threshold of Krippendorff's alpha ≥ 0.800 and per-variable alphas in Appendix Table 4 are given, so iaa_primary_value is -1.0.
